A1+ ([[ICRA Limited|ICRA]]) | website = [https://www.nuvama.com nuvama.com] }} '''Nuvama Wealth Management Limited''' (doing business as '''Nuvama Group''') is an Indian multinational [[wealth management]] company headquartered in Mumbai.{{cite news |last1=Singh |first1=Preeti |last2=Kalesh |first2=Baiju |title=PAG-Backed Indian Asset Manager Eyes Mideast For $400 Million |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-04-04/pag-backed-indian-asset-manager-nuvama-eyes-mideast-for-400-million-fundraising |access-date=6 October 2025 |work=[[Bloomberg News|Bloomberg]] |date=4 April 2024 |language=en}}{{cite web |title=Nuvama Wealth Management Limited |url=https://www.icra.in/Rationale/ShowRationaleReport?Id=136125 |publisher=[[ICRA Limited|ICRA]] |access-date=6 October 2025}} Established in 1993, the company offers services in [[wealth management]], [[asset management]], asset servicing, and [[capital markets]].{{cite web |title=Riding the Wealth Wave; extract:
Nuvama Wealth Management Limited (doing business as Nuvama Group) is an Indian multinational wealth management company headquartered in Mumbai. Established in 1993, the company offers services in wealth management, asset management, asset servicing, and capital markets.
As of June 2025, Nuvama reported assets under management of approximately ₹4.6 trillion (US$48 billion). Since 2021, the company has been majority owned by PAG, a multinational investment firm.
